title: chore(pm): write-pace rule ② default 40 → 80 writes per token-hour
body:
Fixes #31302
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — internal PM tooling under `scripts/pm/`; nothing a metadata author writes moves, and no `skills/**` or docs page states the write budget

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:车队写入节流 `write-pace.mjs` 的每令牌每小时写入上限默认值 40 → 80;脚本头部补上裁决原文与残余风险说明。
- 为什么改:席位与它派出的开发共用同一令牌、同一份计数,席位临时用测试专用变量提到 80 后开发仍按 40 被拒;改默认值让所有进程自动一致(按「写入配额临时增加到80」与「同意」方案 C)。
- 风险与回滚:防封靠的最小间隔、全队单写租约、批量间隔、遇平台退避即停四条都没动;残余风险是同一令牌跑多个容器时每个容器各算 80,会叠加。回滚 = 把常量改回 40 并同步自测里那一处字面钉。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs` —— 常量那一行、头部「Why ② is 80」一节、自测 limits 组新增的字面钉。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs --self-test`,预期 `✓ write-pace self-test: 119 cases pass across 12 batteries`;`node scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs --status` 显示 `budget    : N of 80`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs`: `DEFAULT_HOURLY_MAX` 40 → 80. Rule ② header text now reads 80 / "the 81st is REFUSED". A new header subsection, "Why ② is 80, and what that number does not cover", quotes the ruling (「写入配额临时增加到80」, then 「同意」 to changing the default rather than a per-role override) and states the residual risk: the budget is per token PER CONTAINER, N containers on one token add up, so keep concurrent containers per token small. The reserve-then-sleep paragraph no longer names "the 40th".
- Rules ① min gap (3 s), ③ back-off stop marker (30 min), ④ fleet-wide single in-flight lease and ⑤ batch gap are byte-unchanged. `OS_PM_WRITE_HOURLY_MAX` keeps its FOR-TESTS meaning (untouched).
- Self-test: every case name tied to the cap now follows the constant (battery `rule ②: the first write past the hourly budget is REFUSED, with a prescription`; cases `${DEFAULT_HOURLY_MAX} writes in the window are allowed` and `write ${DEFAULT_HOURLY_MAX + 1} is refused`; the success line). One deliberate literal pin was added in the limits battery, `rule ②'s default is the ruled 80 writes per token-hour` (`DEFAULT_HOURLY_MAX === 80`), so the ruled value cannot drift without a red; that battery's floor rises 10 → 11.
- No changeset: the diff is `scripts/pm/**` only and publishes nothing from any released package, so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Tests

<details><summary>write-pace self-test at 441a43cd33</summary>

```text
$ node scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs --self-test   # head 441a43cd33, exit 0
✓ write-pace self-test: 119 cases pass across 12 batteries — the per-token key that never carries the token, the gap remainder, the refusal past the hourly budget and its prescription, the stop marker a 429 writes, the prune that keeps a long retry-after alive, the lease that kept one write in flight across real processes, the batch gap one process announced and two others obeyed, the shell door, and the nine write transports that call both halves.
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: constant set back to 40 (one-shot, not kept)</summary>

Run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` against the committed head, with a trap restore. The anchor `export const DEFAULT_HOURLY_MAX = 80;` counted 1 before; the mutated anchor `= 40;` counted 1 on disk during the run; the self-test exited 1:

```text
  ✗ rule ②'s default is the ruled 80 writes per token-hour — got 40, want 80
✗ write-pace self-test: 1 of 119 case(s) failed.
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (c5e4330b3e7b) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

Exactly one case went red, the literal pin, which shows every other cap-tied case follows the constant. After restore the anchor counts were new=1 / old=0, and the `git hash-object` of the file equalled the HEAD blob `c5e4330b3e7bc7e130e189e4660ba253c8418291`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Repo-wide grep for the cap (`41st`, `40` near hourly/budget/per-token phrasing, `OS_PM_WRITE_HOURLY_MAX`) across `scripts/`, `.claude/`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/`, `content/docs/`: no other place states the write cap. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` do not quote it, so neither is touched.
- One stale quote is left on purpose: `.github/workflows/lint.yml:1327`, in the comment above the write-pace self-test step, still says "the 41st write in an hour is REFUSED". That file is a Tier H governed surface and outside this claim's file surface, so editing it would turn this PR governed. It is a comment only (the step runs `--self-test`, which follows the constant), and it is handed to the seat.
- `check-governed-merges --branch`: NOT governed, 1 path, +32 / -11.
